Hapag-Lloyd Names New Chief Operating Officer
Hapag-Lloyd named an internal candidate to become its new operating chief, filling a role vacant since summer.

Anders Boenaes, currently senior managing director, network, will take on the role at the start of next month, the German shipping giant said Wednesday. He replaces former chief operating officer Maximilian Rothkopf, who stepped down at the end of June.

Boenaes joined Hapag-Lloyd in 2020 after more than two decades at Danish rival Maersk. In his current role he is responsible for the company's global liner network, the container fleet and global operations.
The company also said it extended the contract of Chief Terminal & Infrastructure Officer Dheeraj Bhatia until the end of 2029.
